contract.label: Input group
contract.summary: An input with attached add-ons. Wrap an InputGroupInput (or Textarea) with InputGroupAddon slots holding icons, text, or buttons.

parts.name: InputGroup
parts.description: Bordered container that visually merges the control and add-ons.

parts.name: InputGroupAddon
parts.description: An add-on slot; align sets inline/block start or end.

parts.name: InputGroupButton
parts.description: A compact button inside an add-on.

parts.name: InputGroupText
parts.description: Muted text inside an add-on (e.g. a unit like kWh).

parts.name: InputGroupInput
parts.description: The text input control inside the group.

parts.name: InputGroupTextarea
parts.description: A multi-line control variant inside the group.

props.name: surface
props.description: What the field sits on — default inside a card, sheet, dialog or table row, where it rests clear so the surface shows through; page straight on the shell's muted content area, where it takes the outline Button's face so a filter row reads as one surface. The group owns the surface; its control stays clear.

rules: **Pick the surface by what is underneath.** A field placed straight on the shell's `muted` content area — a search box, a filter row — takes `surface="page"`, the outline Button's resting face (`outline-surface`), so the row reads as one surface. Inside a `card`, `sheet`, `dialog` or table row it keeps `default`.
antiPatterns: A field on the muted page body given `bg-background`, `bg-card` or `bg-white` instead of `surface="page"` — in dark mode `background` is darker than `card`, so the field sinks below the cards beside it.
